text:
olivia-peopleops: FYI new-hire Anya's EAD renewal (I-765) is still pending. Offer start is 07/01. Legal + payroll, can we confirm whether we can onboard her on 7/1 if only receipt notice is in hand?

anya-candidate: Hi all 3; I filed I-765 on 05/10 and got receipt (I-797C) 06/02. Biometrics scheduled 06/25. Primary concern: will payroll/benefits start on 7/1 or do we need to delay until card arrives?

marta-legal: Short answer: we cannot complete a List A I-9 with just an I-797C receipt. For EAD-based work authorization, the physical EAD (front+back) is required to establish employment eligibility. Options:
- Delay US payroll start until EAD card arrives and I-9 completed.
- If immediate start required, consider starting as unpaid onboarding/volunteer tasks (limited scope) until card arrives.
- If candidate has an alternative valid List A document (e.g., H-1B approval + stamp), that would work.

dave-engineering: Team wants Anya to start ramping on non-prod stuff and docs review from day one. We prefer not to lose her. Any liability doing remote unpaid ramp-up?

marta-legal: Unpaid pre-start work must be strictly non-productive (reading docs, watching recorded trainings, shadowing without delivering output). We'll draft an "unpaid onboarding" checklist. Keep records in case of audit.

rachel-payroll: From payroll side: benefits eligibility and 401(k) enrollment anchor to official hire date. If we treat 7/1 as a "conditional U.S. start" but hold payroll until EAD arrives, benefits won't be active and cannot be retroactive except in limited circumstances. Also we need SSN for tax setup; we can create a placeholder record but cannot remit pay until SSN or ITIN is provided.

anya-candidate: I can apply for SSN after I get the EAD, but timeline's tight. If we delay start, is there a window for benefits sign-up?

rachel-payroll: New-hire benefits enrollment is 30 days from official hire. If we delay hire date to card arrival, you get that window then. If we mark 7/1 as hire but hold benefits, that creates complexity. Recommend syncing hire date with EAD arrival to avoid enrollment gaps.

olivia-peopleops: What about remote I-9 verification? Can we do virtual inspection once card arrives and complete I-9 remotely?

marta-legal: Yes, remote inspection allowed under our vendor's current policy for certain states. We must examine documents live (video) and retain images. We'll schedule a remote I-9 session as soon as EAD is uploaded.

onboard-bot: Upload link: https://onboard.redwood.ai/upload (select 'work auth docs'). Document received: I-797C_receipt.pdf. Status: pending.

anya-candidate: Uploaded receipt now. Will upload card scans when it arrives.

dave-engineering: If we do unpaid onboarding, please confirm what systems she can access. We need at least GitHub read access and the learning portal.

olivia-peopleops: For unpaid ramp-up: grant non-prod GitHub read, training LMS, and calendar invites. No production AWS, secrets, or payroll systems. IT will provision with an "onboarding" role.

dave-engineering: Sounds good. That should keep momentum.

marta-legal: Also remind candidate not to travel internationally before EAD is issued and documented if relying on EAD for work authorization. Travel can complicate the renewal.

anya-candidate: Not planning travel. Thanks.

olivia-peopleops: Plan: 1) Mark start as 07/01 but payroll will be pending until EAD card and I-9 complete; 2) Anya may do unpaid onboarding tasks starting 07/01; 3) Benefits enrollment will open on confirmed hire date after EAD arrival. If EAD doesn't arrive within 4 weeks, we'll reassess for short-term contractor/EoR. I'll update offer letter language and confirm by EOD.

onboard-bot: Scheduled remote I-9 slot pending EAD upload: 2024-07-08 10:00 PST.

rachel-payroll: Noted 3; finance: hold off on payroll account creation until we have EAD front+back and SSN.

olivia-peopleops: Thanks team. Marking thread in-progress; will post updated offer wording and unpaid-onboarding checklist once ready. :memo:

anya-candidate: Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to starting.
